title: Willcutts review of Forrestal's death

tellings.quote: They followed up with a a kind of investigation. I which I read the transcript uh most of it anyway. the Will Cuts uh review I think it's called.

plain: After a former US Defense Secretary named Forrestal died at Bethesda Naval Hospital in Maryland in 1949, the Navy held a follow-up inquiry into his death, known as the Willcutts review, written that year. The researcher Richard Dolan says he has read most of its transcript, and he brings it up on Michels' show while arguing that the Defense Secretary's death was tied to UFOs.
